desc: Implement helper functions for modular inverse and precompute factorials/inverse factorials up to 10^5 for computing combinations C(n, k) mod 10^9+7.
Write a function to compute the sum of absolute differences for all pairs in a 1D array of size L: sum_{0<=i<j<L} |i-j| = L*(L^2-1)/6.
Compute the total Manhattan distance sum across all unordered pairs of cells: x_sum = n * (m*(m^2-1)//6), y_sum = m * (n*(n^2-1)//6), total_dist = x_sum + y_sum.
Compute C(m*n - 2, k - 2) mod 10^9+7 using the precomputed factorials.
Multiply total_dist by C(m*n - 2, k - 2) mod 10^9+7 and return the result.
